scope: APS planning only, p>3 short Weierstrass curves, distinct base abscissae in odd prime-order subgroup, no ordinate zero; horizontal omission only after the existing orbit-label certificate; no global novelty claim
statement: Proposed APS follow-ups from a bounded literature and current-source review: a nonhorizontal line chart U=t^2,V=c/t with H=X^3-U(X+V)^2+aX+b; reuse of native F4 traces across APS attempts with mismatch fallback; disjoint new-tuple frontiers when growing a labeled factor base; and joint optimization of unequal partition sizes and hybrid elimination. The conditional chart-lifting and frontier arguments are producer derivations, not independent proofs. Completeness, cost, trace amortization and performance tests remain pending; no speed or scaling result is asserted.
